summary: Confirmed the /brief dark-mode text-brand-blue fix from iteration_35. All six VIEW DETAILS links (brief-row-delayed/completed/awaiting_approval/absent/complaints/payment_overdue) and the 'employees absent' large count now render as rgb(110,168,255) with a computed WCAG contrast ratio of 7.42:1 against the dark card bg rgb(22,23,28) — well above the 4.5:1 AA threshold. Light-mode regression also passed: the same elements render as rgb(0,47,167) with contrast 10.69:1 against white, so the original dark-blue accent is unchanged. Visual screenshots in both modes confirm readability.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix `.dark .text-brand-blue { color: #6ea8ff; }` in /app/frontend/src/index.css (line 86) is minimal and correctly scoped inside the @layer utilities dark block, and does not affect light mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_35 flagged only the /brief text-brand-blue dark-mode contrast bug; iteration_36 confirms it is fixed and light mode is unaffected. No further action required for this fix. If future dark-mode audits are needed, the app has a global theme-toggle button with data-testid='theme-toggle' in the top nav which can be used to switch modes post-login.
rca of the issue: Root cause was `.text-brand-blue` (defined as #002FA7, deep navy) had no dark-mode override so it produced ~1.67:1 contrast against the dark card. Mitigation: main agent added a dark-mode remap to a lighter #6ea8ff which yields 7.42:1 (AAA) on the dark surface.
